summary: Verified admin Drivers email-visibility bug fix. Backend /api/admin/drivers now returns email joined from users collection. Frontend Admin Drivers tab shows Email column, driver-email-<id> cells, and driver-search box with working filter, empty-state, and clear behavior. All backend pytest cases (4) and Playwright UI checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1193 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth, admin, bookings) for maintainability.
admin_drivers uses one aggregate lookup — good; if driver count grows large, add index on users.user_id (likely already unique).
test_credentials: Admin: anisha91ahmed@gmail.com / MoveAdmin#2026 (from problem statement, verified working).
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_driver_<uuid>@example.com driver via /api/auth/driver-register during backend test; then approved via admin endpoint. Left in DB (prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend admin_drivers join with users works. Preview DB has ~31 drivers with populated email column. UI tab-drivers, admin-drivers-table, driver-email-<id>, driver-search testids all present and functional. Pending badge on Drivers tab shows count (observed 12).
rca of the issue: Original bug: driver_profiles collection had no email field; admin UI rendered only fields on that document, so email was invisible and unsearchable. Fix joins users by user_id in /api/admin/drivers and attaches email; frontend adds Email column + search state filtering name/email/phone/vehicle. Verified end-to-end.
